project.title: Warehouse Heavy-Goods Relocation and Safety Upgrade
project.objective: Plan and execute a phased relocation of heavy and bulky goods inside the warehouse while improving handling safety and efficiency.
deliverables: Detailed relocation layout and move sequence plan
Standard operating procedures for moving and stacking goods
Updated equipment usage and safety guidelines
Completed relocation of targeted zones with sign-off checklist
Incident and near-miss log for the relocation period
constraints: All moves must comply with internal health and safety measures in transportation
No disruption to daily outbound shipments beyond agreed time windows
Use only existing lifting equipment and packaging materials
Dangerous goods must follow specific handling and stacking rules
Relocation must be completed within agreed phased schedule

risks.risk: Injury or incident while moving heavy or dangerous goods.
risks.mitigation: Reinforce safety training, use checklists, and require pre-move equipment and load checks.

risks.risk: Delays impacting regular loading and outbound schedules.
risks.mitigation: Plan moves in low-activity windows and coordinate daily with operations scheduling.

risks.risk: Incorrect stacking or load sequencing causing rework.
risks.mitigation: Document clear stacking patterns and cargo loading sequences with visual aids and sign-off.

risks.risk: Equipment downtime for cranes or forklifts.
risks.mitigation: Schedule preventive checks before phases and keep backup equipment allocation where possible.

themes.theme: Safe handling of heavy and dangerous goods
themes.why_relevant: Core to reducing incidents while relocating bulky and hazardous items.
Minimises double-handling and avoids blocking active loading areas.
Ensures stability of loads in containers and racks during and after moves.
Aligns crane and forklift use with load weight and reach constraints.

themes.theme: Cleaning and readiness of new storage zones
themes.why_relevant: Prevents contamination and prepares surfaces before goods are relocated.

backlog.task: Map current storage layout and identify heavy-goods zones to be relocated
definition_of_done: All aisles and zones with heavy or dangerous goods are listed
Simple sketch or description of current layout is documented
Priority zones for relocation are agreed with operations supervisor

backlog.task: Draft move sequence and routing plan for priority zones
definition_of_done: Move order for each zone is defined with time windows
Main routes for cranes and forklifts are identified
Plan is reviewed for conflicts with regular loading activities

backlog.task: Define stacking patterns and packaging approach for relocated goods
definition_of_done: Recommended stacking heights and patterns are documented
Packaging material types are matched to goods categories
Guidance covers both containers and racks

backlog.task: Create standard operating procedure for handling dangerous goods during relocation
definition_of_done: Step-by-step procedure for loading, moving and unloading dangerous goods is written
Hazard pictograms and warnings are included
Procedure is validated by health and safety officer

backlog.task: Prepare equipment capacity and safety check checklist for cranes and forklifts
definition_of_done: Checklist includes weight limits and visual inspection steps
Checklist covers both cranes and forklifts in use
Checklist is shared and acknowledged by all movers

backlog.task: Plan and execute cleaning of new storage zones before relocation
definition_of_done: Target zones are listed with cleaning dates
Surfaces and racks are cleaned and inspected
Cleaning completion is recorded for each zone

backlog.task: Pilot relocation of one selected zone and capture lessons learned
definition_of_done: One zone is fully relocated according to plan
Any incidents, delays or rework are logged
Improvement points are summarised and shared

backlog.task: Refine move sequence and SOPs based on pilot feedback
definition_of_done: Changes to move sequence are documented
SOPs and checklists are updated where needed
Team confirms understanding of updated documents

backlog.task: Execute full relocation of remaining zones according to updated plan
definition_of_done: All planned zones are relocated to new positions
No unresolved incidents remain open
Operations supervisor signs off completion

backlog.task: Maintain incident and near-miss log for the relocation period
definition_of_done: All incidents and near-misses are recorded with date and brief description
Root cause and immediate action are noted
Summary is shared at project close

backlog.task: Create quick-reference visual guide for stacking and load sequencing
definition_of_done: Guide includes diagrams for typical loads and containers
Load sequencing rules are clearly stated
Guide is printed or posted in loading areas

backlog.task: Verify final layout against plan and update simple layout map
definition_of_done: Actual positions of relocated goods are checked
Any deviations from plan are documented
Final layout map is shared with warehouse team

artifacts.title: Equipment Capacity and Safety Pre-Use Checklist
artifacts.used_for: Used by movers before operating cranes or forklifts for relocation tasks.

artifacts.title: Zone Cleaning and Readiness Checklist

artifacts.used_for: Central record of all incidents and near-misses during the relocation project.

artifacts.used_for: Provides diagrams and rules for stacking goods and determining cargo loading sequence.

artifacts.used_for: Reference for the new layout after relocation, used by all warehouse staff.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Align on scope, zones, and initial move sequence for the relocation project.
threads_plan.trigger: Kickoff message announcing the relocation project and asking for input on priority zones.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Confirm which zones are in scope for the first relocation phase.
Approve the initial move sequence and routing plan in A1 for the pilot zone.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Define and agree on safety procedures and equipment checks.
threads_plan.trigger: Safety-focused message requesting review of draft SOP and equipment checklist.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Approve the dangerous goods handling SOP in A2 for use during relocation.
Agree on mandatory use of the equipment safety checklist A3 before each shift.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Plan cleaning and readiness of new storage zones before moves.
threads_plan.trigger: Message sharing proposed cleaning schedule and asking for confirmation of time windows.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Confirm which team members handle cleaning for each zone and by when.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Run the pilot relocation, capture issues, and agree on improvements.
threads_plan.trigger: Announcement that pilot zone relocation will start, with request to log issues and feedback.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Decide whether the pilot approach is acceptable for full rollout or needs changes.
Agree on specific updates to move plan and SOPs based on pilot lessons.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Coordinate full relocation rollout and confirm final layout.
threads_plan.trigger: Message summarising updated plan and asking for confirmation of rollout dates and final checks.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Confirm final rollout schedule and sign-off criteria for completion of all zones.

channel_rituals: Daily async check-in each morning with planned moves, risks, and blockers for the day.
End-of-day brief summary post capturing completed zones and any incidents or near-misses.
Weekly planning thread to adjust move sequence, cleaning schedule, and equipment allocation.
Post-pilot review thread to agree on changes before full rollout.
Final project wrap-up post summarising outcomes, layout changes, and key safety learnings.
